parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the client.

*   **aliyun_assist**: Cloud Assistant client
*   **aliyun_monitor**: CloudMonitor client

parameters.name: Uuids
parameters.description: The UUID of the server. If you specify multiple UUIDs, separate the UUIDs with commas (,).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas install-pm-agent --source-ip 58.35.xx.xx --lang zh --uuids inet-a6444920-d303-4ccf-ab87-a1d3cd490000 --type aliyun_monitor --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas InstallPmAgent --region cn-hangzhou --Type aliyun_monitor --SourceIp '58.35.xx.xx' --Lang zh --Uuids 'inet-a6444920-d303-4ccf-ab87-a1d3cd490000'
